# Christophe Foulon
760-880-5395 | christophefoulon@gmail.com | https://www.linkedin.com/in/christophefoulon | Washington, D.C. Metro / Remote

### CHIEF INFORMATION SECURITY OFFICER (CISO)
*Enterprise Information Security Leadership | vCISO & Cyber Advisory | GRC & Cloud Architecture*

### EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
Transformational Cybersecurity Executive & Board Advisor with 20+ years of leadership designing and executing resilient information security programs across Fortune 10 enterprises and high-growth SaaS environments. Proven track record aligning enterprise risk management (NIST CSF 2.0, ISO 27001, SOC 2 Type II, HIPAA) with strategic business objectives and revenue enablement. Deep technical oversight across multi-cloud infrastructure (AWS, Azure), DevSecOps pipelines, identity governance (IAM/Zero Trust), and automated threat detection & response (SIEM/EDR, Sentinel, Defender). Recognized industry author and mentor known for cultivating high-performing security teams, navigating complex regulatory landscapes, and translating technical risk into actionable boardroom metrics.

### CORE COMPETENCIES & LEADERSHIP PILLARS
* **Executive Leadership & Governance:** Cybersecurity Program Strategy, Enterprise Risk Management (ERM), FAIR Risk Quantification, Board & Executive Reporting, Regulatory Compliance (SOC 2 Type II, ISO 27001, CMMC, NIST CSF 2.0, HIPAA, PCI DSS, FFIEC, SOX Readiness), Security Budget & P&L Oversight, M&A Cybersecurity Due Diligence.
* **Cloud Security & Architecture:** Multi-Cloud Security (AWS, Azure, Azure Government, FedRAMP), Secure SDLC, DevSecOps CI/CD Security Gates, Compliance-as-Code (Python / REST APIs), Zero Trust Architecture, Identity & Access Management (IAM / RBAC), Container & Kubernetes Hardening, Infrastructure as Code (Terraform) Security.
* **SecOps, Telemetry & Resilience:** Incident Response & Crisis Management, Threat Intelligence (LOB Integration), SIEM & Telemetry (Microsoft Sentinel), Endpoint Detection & Response (EDR / Defender for Endpoint / CrowdStrike), Network Security & IDS/IPS, Vulnerability Management (SAST / DAST), BCDR.
* **Business Enablement & Culture:** Cross-Functional Alignment, Engineering Partnership, Third-Party & Supply Chain Risk Management (TPRM), Security Culture & Mentorship, Vendor Negotiations & Executive Stakeholder Management.

### PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE

#### CPF COACHING LLC | 2007 – Present
**Fractional Executive Advisor / Virtual CISO (vCISO)**
* Spearheaded Fractional CISO (vCISO) engagements across 15+ high-growth SaaS, fintech, and mid-market enterprises (1–500 employees), designing risk-proportionate cybersecurity programs aligned with NIST CSF, ISO 27001, and SOC 2 Type II that directly unlocked enterprise sales pipelines.
* Guided multiple organizations through first-time SOC 2 Type II and ISO 27001 certification processes from scratch, achieving audit readiness within 6 to 9 months from engagement start.
* Architected automated Compliance-as-Code frameworks leveraging Python scripts and cloud REST APIs (AWS/Azure) to continuously audit IAM policies, S3/blob encryption, and CIS baseline drift, cutting recurring compliance audit prep time by 60%.
* Directed technical security baseline implementation across hybrid Linux/cloud container workloads, integrating automated vulnerability scanning, DevSecOps CI/CD security gates, and infrastructure-as-code (Terraform) validation checks.
* Instituted continuous security monitoring and MDR/SIEM oversight (Microsoft Sentinel / Defender / CrowdStrike), defining threat detection playbooks, IDS/IPS telemetry rules, and incident triage runbooks that reduced mean time to response (MTTR) by 45%.
* Bridged executive boardrooms and engineering squads, translating technical risk telemetry into quantifiable FAIR business metrics to secure stakeholder buy-in and prioritize engineering remediations without stalling sprint velocity.
* Provided executive-level cybersecurity advisory and vCISO services across premier MSSP partnerships (Quisitive, Nexigen, Format Cyber, SideChannel), architecting tailored cybersecurity strategies (NIST CSF, ISO 27001, HIPAA, PCI DSS) for clients ranging from healthcare entities to national franchises.

#### QUISITIVE | 2024 – Present
**Security Coach & Executive Advisor**
* Directed strategic security advisory and Virtual CISO engagements for Quisitive, a premier Microsoft Security Partner, elevating client cybersecurity maturity, governance, and compliance posture across diverse industry sectors.
* Leveraged deep expertise in the Microsoft security ecosystem, guiding enterprise clients through the strategic implementation and operationalization of native cloud tooling (Azure Security Center, Microsoft Defender for Cloud, Microsoft Sentinel, Microsoft 365 Defender suite) to maximize security ROI.
* Oversaw the delivery of advanced managed security services (Spyglass Managed Security, Azure Managed Services), establishing proactive threat detection and response architectures across Microsoft 365, Defender for Endpoint, and cloud infrastructures.

#### CAPITAL ONE | McLean, VA | October 2020 – October 2023
**Senior Manager, Cybersecurity & Technology Risk Oversight**
* Led enterprise-scale cyber risk assessments and technical control evaluations across critical multi-cloud (AWS) infrastructure and regulated banking applications supporting 50M+ active cardholders within a Fortune 10 financial institution (B+ revenue).
* Engineered automated continuous control monitoring (CCM) pipelines utilizing Python and internal API connectors to programmatically validate technical compliance across distributed Linux instances, Kubernetes clusters, and API gateways.
* Governed enterprise IAM and Zero Trust security architecture across 100+ matrixed Agile development and security teams, enforcing least-privilege RBAC, KMS key management, and cryptographic standards across CI/CD deployment pipelines.
* Embedded DevSecOps security gates across core financial applications, standardizing SAST/DAST vulnerability remediation SLAs and reducing production vulnerability escapes while accelerating secure release velocity.
* Spearheaded the development and launch of a critical Line of Business (LOB) Threat Intelligence program for the Card division, integrating external threat feeds with internal process telemetry—increasing executive readership by 200% and driving proactive risk mitigation.
* Delivered executive risk reporting and audit defensibility for federal regulatory bodies (OCC, Federal Reserve) and internal audit committees, demonstrating robust automated governance over CSPM and perimeter defenses.

#### GRIMM SMFS INC | Washington, D.C. | December 2019 – October 2020
**Senior Security Consultant (SMF)**
* Delivered high-impact strategic cybersecurity advisory services to federal and commercial clients, expertly integrating and operationalizing industry-leading frameworks (NIST CSF, CMMC, ISO 27001) to elevate client security maturity.
* Initiated and led the development of an advanced cyber range training platform, significantly enhancing client capabilities in real-world attack simulations, network packet analysis (Wireshark), and incident response exercises.
* Managed end-to-end delivery of a six-module Cyber Maturity Builder program, empowering clients to proactively identify and mitigate complex threats within virtualized environments.
* Provided expert consulting across diverse security domains, including threat modeling for Secure SDLCs, enterprise risk assessments for pharmaceutical clients, and M&A cybersecurity due diligence.

#### CONQUEST FEDERAL | Washington, D.C. | February 2019 – December 2019
**Lead Cyber Risk Management Consultant**
* Spearheaded the architectural design, security authorization, and digital transformation strategies for federal agencies, modernizing cloud security posture and federal compliance baselines (NIST SP 800-53, FedRAMP, FISMA).

### AUTHORED PUBLICATIONS & THOUGHT LEADERSHIP
* **Co-Author**, *Develop Your Cybersecurity Career Path*
* **Co-Author**, *Hack the Cybersecurity Interview*
* **Host & Executive Producer**, *Breaking Into Cybersecurity* Podcast (Educating & mentoring emerging security practitioners and leaders globally)
* **Industry Keynote Speaker & Executive Contributor** on Cyber Risk Quantification (FAIR), vCISO Practice Building, and Enterprise DevSecOps.

### TECHNICAL SKILLS & TOOLING MATRIX
* **Cloud & Infrastructure:** AWS (IAM, CloudTrail, GuardDuty, KMS, S3), Microsoft Azure (Azure Portal, Entra ID, Defender for Cloud), Linux Hardening, Kubernetes/Containers, Terraform.
* **Security Operations & Tooling:** Microsoft Sentinel (SIEM), Microsoft Defender Suite (XDR/EDR), CrowdStrike Falcon, Wireshark, IDS/IPS, Next-Gen Firewalls, Vulnerability Scanners (Tenable, Qualys).
* **Automation & Engineering:** Python Scripting (Compliance-as-Code, API Integration), REST APIs, CI/CD Pipeline Security Gates, GitHub Actions / GitLab CI.
* **Frameworks & Methodologies:** NIST CSF 2.0, NIST SP 800-53, ISO 27001, SOC 2 Type II, CMMC, HIPAA, PCI DSS, FFIEC, FAIR, Secure SDLC.

### EDUCATION & CREDENTIALS
* **Certifications:** CompTIA Security+ | Microsoft Certified: Security Operations & Azure Fundamentals | Formal Executive GRC & Risk Methodologies
* **Education:** Relevant Degree / Executive Education Credentials (available upon request)
